mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, u.major AS author_major, pu.name AS reply_to_author_name FROM task_comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN task_comments pc ON c.parent_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN users pu ON pc.author_id = pu.id WHERE c.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_comments (task_id, author_id, parent_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{authorId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE task_comments SET task_id = #{taskId}, author_id = #{authorId}, parent_id = #{parentId}, content = #{content}, like_count = #{likeCount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
